headline.en: UNI ripped 25.48% on $18.22M of volume while net emission stayed +1.79%: a thin rally, not a re-rating.
headline.zh: UNI 一周涨25.48%却只有$18.22M成交量,净增发仍是+1.79%:薄流动性反弹,不是价值重估。

keyChanges.en: Price +25.48% on the week to $4.1570 but flat over 24h, on only $18.22M volume against a $2.59B free float and $22.13M open interest — a thin, unleveraged spot bid that has already stalled.
keyChanges.zh: 周涨25.48%至$4.1570,但24h基本走平,成交量仅$18.22M(对应$2.59B自由流通市值)、open interest(未平仓合约)仅$22.13M——薄现货买盘、无杠杆参与,且动能已停滞。

keyChanges.en: The rally mechanically worsens the burn: $16.90M annual buyback (17% of $99.41M annualized revenue) retires only 4,065,357 UNI against 20M emission, net +15,934,643 UNI (+1.79%/yr). Breakeven at current revenue is $0.845, or revenue must hit ~$489M (4.9x).
keyChanges.zh: 上涨反而削弱销毁效果:$16.90M年度buyback(回购,占年化收入$99.41M的17%)只能销毁4,065,357枚UNI,对上20M年度增发,净增发+15,934,643枚(+1.79%/年)。当前收入下的盈亏平衡价是$0.845,否则收入需做到约$489M(4.9倍)。

keyChanges.en: TVL +169.64% to $7.89B is uncorroborated: annualized revenue is still just $99.41M, and holders capture $16.90M of a ~$1.11B annualized gross fee stream — about 1.5%. LPs take the rest.
keyChanges.zh: TVL(锁仓总价值)+169.64%至$7.89B缺乏交叉验证:年化收入仍只有$99.41M,而年化约$1.11B的总手续费中持币人仅拿到$16.90M,约1.5%,其余归LP。

contrarianObservation.en: Two live temp checks — Activate v4 Protocol Fees and Protocol Fee Expansion: Robinhood Chain — attack the exact variable that fixes net inflation: the revenue numerator, where most v4 flow is currently untaxed. That is a multiple, not a margin. With long/short account ratio at 0.84 (retail already short), funding at +0.01% and only $22.13M of OI, there is no positioning resistance for a governance headline to grind against, and at $4.1570 the treasury sits 30% below its own $5.96 burn mark — a rational bid, not a seller.
contrarianObservation.zh: 两个在讨论的temp check——Activate v4 Protocol Fees 与 Robinhood Chain 手续费扩张——正好打在修复净通胀的那个变量上:收入端。v4 目前大部分流量尚未收费,这是倍数级增量,不是边际改善。而 long/short 账户比0.84(散户已偏空)、funding rate(资金费率)仅+0.01%、OI 只有$22.13M,意味着任何治理利好几乎不需要对抗持仓阻力;$4.1570 也比 DAO 自己的$5.96销毁成本低30%,国库在这个位置理性上是买方而非卖方。

watchNext.en: [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees and the Robinhood Chain fee expansion — whether they get revenue sizing and an on-chain vote date. This is the only lever that can flip net emission negative without a price collapse.
watchNext.zh: [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees 与 Robinhood Chain 手续费扩张:是否给出收入量化和链上投票时间表。这是在价格不崩的前提下唯一能把净增发翻负的杠杆。

watchNext.en: Verify the +169.64% TVL print against DefiLlama adapter/chain changes and 7d fee growth. If fees don't follow within two weeks, that liquidity was mercenary or mis-indexed — treat the $7.89B as noise.
watchNext.zh: 对照 DefiLlama 的 adapter/新链纳入情况与7天手续费增速,验证+169.64%的TVL读数。若两周内手续费不跟上,说明是套利型流动性或口径错记,$7.89B按噪声处理。

watchNext.en: Absence of a real-yield RFC. No active proposals and nothing in the top-5 forum threads redirecting buybacks to stakers — the 2026 DCF re-rate slips another quarter, leaving the Timelock's 267.2M UNI (30% of non-burned supply, ~$1.11B) as the standing overhang.
watchNext.zh: real yield(实际收益)RFC 的缺席:目前无在投提案,前五热帖也没有把回购转向质押者的内容——2026年的DCF重估再推一个季度,而 Timelock 手中267.2M UNI(未销毁供给的30%,约$1.11B)仍是悬顶抛压。

fullReasoning.en: The tape is up 25.48% on the week and nothing structural changed. That is the trade. $18.22M of 24h volume against a $2.59B free float, with $22.13M of open interest and +0.01% funding, means this was a thin spot bid — no leverage stack underneath it, no dated catalyst above it, and 24h change already flat at -0.02%. The arithmetic is worse after the rally, not better: the $16.90M annual buyback (17% of $99.41M annualized revenue) retires 4,065,357 UNI against 20M of emission, leaving +15,934,643 net, +1.79% of float. Burn scales inversely with price, so every up-day shrinks the offset. Breakeven at current revenue is $0.845; alternatively revenue must reach ~$489M, roughly 4.9x. Meanwhile holders capture $16.90M of an annualized ~$1.11B gross fee stream, about 1.5% — LPs take the rest. That is the honest reason UNI trades 30% below the DAO's own $5.96 burn mark. The +169.64% TVL print to $7.89B is corroborated by nothing else in this snapshot; I treat it as an indexing or adapter change until 7d fee growth confirms it. Note also the cap/FDV split: $2.59B reflects ~623M genuinely free float while the Timelock holds 267.2M UNI, 30% of non-burned supply. No active proposals, no real-yield RFC in flight. Sell strength into $4.40-4.60.
fullReasoning.zh: 本周价格涨25.48%,但结构性变量一个都没变——这就是交易机会所在。$18.22M的24h成交量对应$2.59B自由流通市值,加上仅$22.13M的open interest(未平仓合约)和+0.01%的funding rate(资金费率),说明这是薄现货买盘:下方没有杠杆堆积,上方没有确定日期的催化剂,24h已经走平在-0.02%。反弹之后算术更难看:$16.90M的年度buyback(回购,占年化收入$99.41M的17%)只能销毁4,065,357枚UNI,对上20M年度增发,净增发+15,934,643枚,相当于流通量的+1.79%。销毁量与价格反向,价格每涨一档,对冲效果就更弱。当前收入下的盈亏平衡价是$0.845;换个算法,收入要做到约$489M,即4.9倍。同时,年化约$1.11B的总手续费里,持币人只拿到$16.90M,约1.5%,其余归LP。这才是UNI比DAO自己$5.96销毁成本低30%的真实原因。TVL(锁仓总价值)+169.64%至$7.89B在本快照里没有任何交叉验证,在7天手续费增速确认之前,我按索引或adapter口径变更处理。另外注意市值与FDV的差异:$2.59B对应约623M真正自由流通,而Timelock仍持有267.2M UNI,占未销毁供给的30%。当前无在投提案,real yield的RFC也未启动。策略:在$4.40-4.60区间逢强减持。
